content: {"summary":"The incident was traced to a new filter on `expires_at` added in the July 2025 release; the missing index caused full table scans, confirmed by simultaneous errors on both inventory pods and a sequential‑scan query plan, and the fix was building the `reservations_expires_at_idx` index concurrently.","likely_cause":"Missing index on `expires_at` column caused a sequential scan of the reservations table after the release added a filter.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The release added a filter on `expires_at` without an index","evidence_ids":["INC-0059#0"],"quote":"That morning's release changed the reservation query so that it filtered on `expires_at`.
